title: Great Lakes Synthetic Longitudinal Health Records
description: A privacy-reduced, fully synthetic relational course dataset generated with Synthea for Wisconsin and Minnesota patients.

coverage.geography: Synthetic patients assigned to Wisconsin and Minnesota
coverage.pilot_population: Target living population of 2,500 patients per state, plus retained deceased histories; total generated population recorded in source_manifest.json
coverage.interpretation: Records describe a simulated health system and cannot support claims about real patients, clinical effectiveness, or population prevalence.

synthetic_extensions.appointments: Deterministically generated from eligible completed Synthea encounters plus additional fictional no-show, cancellation, and rescheduling records that have no encounter.
synthetic_extensions.patient_satisfaction: Deterministically generated survey invitations and numeric responses tied to encounters. Nonresponse, wait-time effects, mode effects, and response bias are intentionally retained.
synthetic_extensions.provenance_rule: Extension rows are labeled course_generated_extension and must not be represented as native Synthea output or real operational records.

terminology_boundary.public_model: Diagnosis and procedure concepts are released only as independent ECO 230 category and group labels. Source descriptions and SNOMED CT, ICD-10-CM, CDT, CPT, or HCPCS identifiers are not included in those public fields.
terminology_boundary.private_model: The ignored local DuckDB work database retains source concepts and an optional reviewed crosswalk to internal ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, or other standard codes. Private crosswalk files and internal tables are never release artifacts.
terminology_boundary.taxonomy_note: ECO 230 labels are an independently authored teaching taxonomy inspired by common two-level service-line analysis. They are not Sg2 group assignments and must not be represented as an Sg2 product.

join_keys.design_note: Natural table grains are intentionally retained. Students must aggregate repeated diagnoses, procedures, medications, observations, and claim transactions before joining them to encounter- or patient-level measures.

course_redactions: synthetic SSNs, driver's-license numbers, passport numbers, member IDs, and device identifiers
street addresses, phone numbers, ZIP codes, cities, birthplaces, and exact coordinates
source UUIDs and claim line notes
privacy.assessment: Every clinical record is generated and describes no real person. Identifier-like synthetic fields are nevertheless removed to model privacy-minimizing health-data practice. The release must always be labeled fully synthetic, never deidentified real data.

restrictions: attribute Synthea and the ECO 230 adaptation
include the required LOINC and requested RxNorm notices
keep SNOMED CT, CDT, CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, and private crosswalk content out of public artifacts
do not represent simulated findings as evidence about real patients or clinical effectiveness

artifacts.name: appointments
artifacts.grain: One scheduled appointment, including appointments that did not result in encounters

artifacts.name: satisfaction_surveys
artifacts.grain: One patient-satisfaction survey invitation, including nonresponses

artifacts.name: diagnoses
artifacts.grain: One condition episode documented at an encounter

artifacts.name: medications
artifacts.grain: One medication episode associated with an encounter

artifacts.name: observations
artifacts.grain: One laboratory, vital-sign, or assessment result

artifacts.name: claim_transactions
artifacts.grain: One charge, payment, adjustment, or transfer transaction on a claim

artifacts.name: coverage_periods
artifacts.grain: One continuous payer-coverage period for a patient

artifacts.name: organizations
artifacts.grain: One healthcare organization used in the simulation

artifacts.name: encounter_analysis
artifacts.grain: One encounter with selected utilization and follow-up summaries
